nom: APRILSKIN Calendula Flower-Infused Facial Peel Off Mask

avis.titre: THIS STUFF IS THE REAL DEAL!! WILL BE RE-BUYING FOREVER AND EVER AND EVER AND EVER
avis.texte: This mask has it ALL!!! Not only does it balance out your skin tone, moisturize and nourish the skin, minimize pores and wrinkles, brightens the skin, BUT IT ALSO CLEARS OUT BLACK-/WHITEHEADS???? it's literally all my skin products and masks put into one bottle T-T <3 It's a dream come true; a face mask that is truly a one-hit wonder <3 <3 <3 <3 Although it might be worth mentioning that this stuff as a detoxifier is hardcore; the first day after using it, my face started to break out a bit, but only because it *continues* to bring out the toxins in your face. By day 2, my face was clearing up and looking pretty. And by day 3??? i literally looked 2yrs younger (i even got some compliments)!! As i've continued using the face mask over the past month or so since purchasing it, this remains consistent; your face looks better and better as the days pass, resulting to the skin becoming smooth and glossy like a k-pop star (just like the advertisement said it would) after a couple days!! Also worth mentioning that the mask is sticky and thick. Like with most masks, i used my face mask applicator tool thingy, but found that to be rather frustrating with this stuff :/ So now i instead simply wash my hands first, then apply the mask with my fingers; makes it a lot easier. Also, i found that even if i think i applied it on a bit too thick, it still dries the same so that's cool ^-^ You should definitely buy this! You won't regret it!

avis.titre: Decent Face Mask, But Don’t Try the TikTok Makeup Hack
avis.texte: This face mask is good, but not amazing. It feels nice on the skin, dries quickly, and is super satisfying to peel off. I’d say it does provide gentle exfoliation since it contains PHA, BHA, and Niacinamide, but I haven’t noticed any significant brightening effects or pore minimization. I originally bought this after seeing a TikTok reel suggesting you can apply the mask, let it dry, and then apply makeup over it for a seamless, blemish-free look. Let me save you the trouble—**DON’T.** While it looks flawless at first (if you try it, dab your makeup, don’t rub), the real issue comes a few hours later. I had a blemish on my nose and thought this trick was working… until midday at work when I caught something out of the corner of my eye. I ignored it at first, only to later realize that the mask had started peeling off on its own, leaving what looked like a giant dry skin flake on my nose. To make matters worse, it took my foundation with it, leaving a completely bare patch that I had to deal with for the rest of the day. Overall, as a regular peel-off mask, it’s nice and enjoyable to use, but if you’re expecting dramatic skin benefits or trying to use it as a makeup hack, you might be disappointed!

Korean skincare has been touted as the 'best' so I was eager to check out this face peel. I chose it after seeing a YouTuber brag about it. (sorry- can't recall who it was now.) I used a silicone applicator brush to apply it to my face and neck (see my review of it- HIGHLY recommend that product). It has a watery hair gel consistency so I didn't want to apply with my hands. The product goes on easily with an applicator and dries fairly quickly. Once dry, it also peels off easily without any flaking (YAY!) and does not rip your skin as you remove it (which I have had happen with other brands.) Overall, my skin felt cleaner afterwards, but I wouldn't say it felt softer or more supple having used it. (bummer- that's why I bought it!) I used it on a weekly basis for several weeks but didn't notice any difference in my skin's appearance. The container isn't very big either (It's smaller than a normal sized tube of toothpaste) so I would say you will be lucky to stretch it out to 6 weeks if you use it weekly on your face and neck. You want to make sure to apply it thick enough so you can easily peel it off when dry. This product is 'okay' but I am going to continue searching for something better since I don't feel this made much of a difference to my skin.

Licensed Esthetician here! Loveeeee this mask! It helps resurface your skin and bring out a youthful glow. It’s great for sensitive skin too. Clears up acne. Can be used as spot treatment. It’s a gel mask that becomes a peel off mask with no pain. Super gentle.

Difficult to peel off so I just let it dry and rinse off. In my opinion it doesnt matter because I saw better skin the next morning(I use ever other evening). Helped reduce dry red patches, minimized pores and left my skin glowy. I ordered the cleanser just now. Very impressed by this high quality yet reasonably priced product.

I cannot say enough positive things about April Skin products. They never disappoint. This peel off mask cleans out the gunk in my pores and removes dead skin. My skin feels soft after use. It has little to no scent. Quality ingredients, vegan and no animal testing. Great price for a quality product. I highly recommend.

This feels very light. I left it on for 15 minutes and that was plenty. Easy to peel off. I used it for the first time tonight. I'll use it twice a week for sure. It gets the dirt and makeup off. I'll have to see my progress in a month.

Review I was very disappointed to find a foreign object inside the product. This is a cosmetic that goes directly on my skin, so finding an unknown substance inside is very concerning. I expected much better quality control. I would not feel comfortable using this product again.

I have only used it twice and i noticed a huge improvements with not only my complexion but also my skin texture. For those with dry and sensitive skin; i would 100% recommend this product. It is easy to apply and doesn't take long to dry. 10/10

My skin feels nice enough after using this mask but there are two big cons that make me hesitant to reorder this. 1. You need to use a fair bit to create a thick enough layer that doesn't break off into bits while removing it. 2. It has a very strong, glue like smell. It's really overpowering and having to put so much on your face doesn't help. I'll keep using it but I'm not sure if the results I gain are significant enough to justify the cost and cons.
To my negligence i totally overlooked the product description. Its NOT moldy. The particles are petals in the product. Please read the full description and disregard the negative reviews.

avis.titre: Great for tweens and people with sensitive skin, not super strong
avis.texte: First, as some other reviewers mentioned, the tube is only filled half way and there is no safety seal. That being said, it smells very nice, and it is easy to apply and peel off. My daughter and I used this tonight and we liked it, it made our skin very smooth. But do not expect this to pull all the impurities out of your pores, it’s not that strong.

avis.titre: An OK peel but doesn't remove white/black head.
avis.texte: It doesnt arrived as a full product. It doesnt take out my white head and black head like those review's hype videos. It does hydrate the skin. As I apply by my finger, the product has a glue type texture and dry up very quickly. So 1 tube may only last to like 4-5 weeks if you do it once a week. I think the Indian clay mud powder mask mix with honey, lemon and special oil would better and more affordable.
it’s incredible I don’t think anything’s work so well for me I’m in love with Korean skincare!

product was amazing until out of nowhere small pieces of whatever this is started to appear, really sad about this i had purchased this a month ago and for this to happen out of nowhere definitely ruined my love for the face mask.

My bottle came with what clearly looks like mold? Ive used calendula masks before and theres never been black bits in it. This is not spread throughout either, its confined to one part in the tube. This was sealed, but I dont know how well for this to happen??
Box was unsealed, bottle unsealed and residue on it. Can’t say that I would recommend a product I can’t use.

The product that I received was not sealed and almost half the bottle/product was used up (see photo). It also doesn’t live up to the hype, but if you want to try it, I recommend buying it from a legit retailer.
This item arrived half full as if it were used! Where's the rest?

I rarely do reviews but after multiple uses of this peel off mask I am hooked. It does exactly what it’s supposed to do. Extracts stubborn clogged pores & it’s so satisfying to see the debris when you peel it off. Great stuff!!!

Got this product 2 weeks ago, been using it 2 times a week. So far it’s made my skin look less dull. I’ll update if any reactions but so far it seems pretty good. You need alot of it in order to peel off. But you can always wash off. It’s all clean ingredients!!

Note: make sure to patch test before applying any facial product. This is a gentle peel off mask infused with skin-calming Calendula Flowers that exfoliates dead skin cells, gunk and pore-clogging impurities without irritation. I love peeling it off leaving my skin very soft and ready for my toner, serum and moisturizer.

This exfoliating mask doesn't irritate my skin. I saw a hack on YouTube that I tried: putting a little mask on my pimple, waiting 5 minutes, and then finishing with my makeup. I did notice it had nice coverage, so my pimple isn't too obvious.

I’m not sure how the product works yet but there’s such a massive air bubble at the top of this bottle I’m not sure I’m getting my moneys worth. Doesn’t look like 3.52 oz. It must be oz not Fluid ounce.

I’ve been obsessing over k-beauty wrapping masks. I’ve tried a medicube one and a medipeel one. Loved both. So I decided to try this one. It has great for your skin ingredients like calendula, niacinimide, BHA and PHA. It is best for oily skin, clogged pores, blackheads/whiteheads, sebaceous filaments. I don’t have major issues with any of that. After peeling it off, I didn’t see much of a glow and my face felt tight. It was a disappointment because I automatically compared it to the other wrapping masks I’d tried. But clearly I’m not the demographic for this product. I should’ve read carefully.

I've tried different facial products and I always check the ingredients before buying any facial product. I used the AprilSkin calendula peel off mask several times before writing this review and I can say it's great. I let it stay on my skin untill it doesn't feel cold when I touch it. I suggest using it before shower because when it sticks to your hair it's easier to remove it by water. It is definitely one of the best facial masks I've ever used till now.
I use this facial mask once a week and it’s easy to apply to my face It leaves my skin soft and not dry . The scent was pleasant I love this product
In this product there's a huge bubble so 1/3 of it was already gone and the box was opened. So I don't know if someone used it and then gave it to me ir it's just originally 1/3 air.

I thought it might be dirt but the black stuff moves with the gel so I know it's part of it. I saw this and thought I’d give it a try. Absolutely FELL IN LOVE after the first use. My skin was sssoooooooo plump and hydrated. I am stunned at how improved my skin is after one use. I feel like I just got a facial. Can’t recommend enough 🤍🤍🤍
